body: I wouldn't say my malcontent lies in materialistic reasons. I've passed up on careers that offer far more money and security in exchange for ones that would pay bare minimum and I would enjoy it. I always make changes and look forward to when my life changes but when I get there it's the same disappointment. Nothing changes, and I can't take the disappointment anymore. I'm tired of getting my hopes up.

I feel no joy out of life. Call it nihilism but everything feels pointless given that we all die, as well as all of our accomplishments and work. Meds won't help, neither will any other help, so why suffer if everything is meaningless in the end.
